title: Combination of Ibrutinib and As2O3 in the Treatment of CLL
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the combination of As2O3 and ibrutinib is synergistic in chronic lymphocytic leukemia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients fulfilling clinical and immune-phenotypic criteria for CLL

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
